<!-- Generated by `pnpm --filter @outstaff/protocol run docs:protocol`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Protocol version: **1**. Agents open the connection to the office; the office never connects to an agent. The messages are defined once, as schemas in the `@outstaff/protocol` package, which both sides use.

## Framing

Messages are JSON text frames over a WebSocket. Every message has this shape:

```json
{ "id": "m1", "replyTo": "m0", "type": "heartbeat", "payload": {} }
```

- `id` is unique per sender. `replyTo` is set on a response and holds the `id` of the request.
- A request gets exactly one response: the result message listed for it, `ack`, or `error`.
- The first message from the agent must be `hello`. Anything else gets an `unauthenticated` error and the connection closes.
- A message that is not valid JSON, has an unknown `type`, or has a payload that does not match gets an `error` back. The connection stays open.
- Frames are limited to 1 MiB.

## Connection life cycle

1. The agent connects and sends `hello` with its handle, token and protocol version.
2. The office answers `welcome`, or `error` and closes the connection (`auth_failed`, `version_mismatch`). The close codes are 4401 and 4426.
3. The office offers the next work item, or offers again the items that were not accepted before. The agent sends `accept` (or `decline`).
4. While working the agent sends `heartbeat` at least every `heartbeatMs`, `progress` and `journal` as it goes, and finally `handback` or `fail`. The office then offers the next item.
5. A person has one connection. A new connection with valid credentials replaces the old one, which closes with code 4409.
6. After a disconnect the agent reconnects with backoff and sends `hello` again. `welcome.resume` lists accepted items still unfinished, and unaccepted offers are delivered again.

Delivery is at least once and idempotent by work item id: an offer may arrive twice, and `accept`, `handback` and the other item messages may be repeated safely.

## Error codes

`malformed`, `unknown_type`, `invalid_message`, `unauthenticated`, `auth_failed`, `version_mismatch`, `replaced`, `unknown_item`, `not_found`, `invalid`, `unsupported`, `failed`.

## Messages

### `hello`

First message on every connection. Authenticates the person and checks the protocol version.

Sent by: agent. Answered by: `welcome`, `error`.

| Field             | Type    | Required | Description                              |
| ----------------- | ------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `person`          | string  | yes      | Handle of the person this agent runs as. |
| `token`           | string  | yes      | The person's agent token.                |
| `protocolVersion` | integer | yes      | PROTOCOL_VERSION the agent speaks.       |
| `agentVersion`    | string  | yes      | Version of the agent software.           |

### `welcome`

The connection is accepted. Lists accepted items to resume.

Sent by: office.

| Field             | Type           | Required | Description                                                       |
| ----------------- | -------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `protocolVersion` | integer        | yes      | PROTOCOL_VERSION the office speaks.                               |
| `heartbeatMs`     | integer        | yes      | Send a heartbeat at least this often.                             |
| `resume`          | list of string | yes      | Ids of accepted, unfinished items the agent should carry on with. |

### `offer`

A work item for the agent to take, with its context. Delivered at least once: an offer that was not accepted is sent again after a reconnect, so handle the same id twice.

Sent by: office.

| Field                      | Type                                             | Required | Description                                                           |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `workItem`                 | object                                           | yes      | The item to work on.                                                  |
| `workItem.id`              | string                                           | yes      |                                                                       |
| `workItem.kind`            | string                                           | yes      | What the work is, for example a ticket, a review round or a question. |
| `workItem.title`           | string                                           | yes      |                                                                       |
| `workItem.priority`        | number                                           | yes      | Lower runs first.                                                     |
| `workItem.trigger`         | `human` or `agent` or `automation` or `schedule` | yes      |                                                                       |
| `workItem.parentId`        | string                                           | no       | The item this one was split from, for questions.                      |
| `workItem.subject`         | object                                           | no       |                                                                       |
| `workItem.subject.type`    | string                                           | yes      |                                                                       |
| `workItem.subject.ref`     | string                                           | yes      |                                                                       |
| `context`                  | object                                           | yes      | What the agent needs to start.                                        |
| `context.journal`          | list of objects                                  | yes      | What earlier rounds of this item recorded.                            |
| `context.journal[].at`     | string                                           | yes      | ISO-8601 timestamp.                                                   |
| `context.journal[].author` | string                                           | yes      | Handle of the author.                                                 |
| `context.journal[].text`   | string                                           | yes      |                                                                       |
| `context.subjects`         | list of objects                                  | yes      | The tickets, pull requests and people the item concerns.              |
| `context.subjects[].type`  | string                                           | yes      | Kind of subject, for example a ticket or a pull request.              |
| `context.subjects[].ref`   | string                                           | yes      | Reference of the subject in its system.                               |
| `context.subjects[].title` | string                                           | no       | Human-readable title.                                                 |
| `context.subjects[].url`   | string                                           | no       | Link to the subject.                                                  |
| `context.links`            | list of objects                                  | yes      | Further links worth opening.                                          |
| `context.links[].url`      | string                                           | yes      | Absolute URL.                                                         |
| `context.links[].title`    | string                                           | no       | Label for the link.                                                   |

### `accept`

Takes an offered item. Accepting twice is harmless.

Sent by: agent. Answered by: `ack`, `error`.

| Field        | Type   | Required | Description          |
| ------------ | ------ | -------- | -------------------- |
| `workItemId` | string | yes      | Id of the work item. |

### `decline`

Gives an offered item back to the queue.

Sent by: agent. Answered by: `ack`, `error`.

| Field        | Type   | Required | Description                       |
| ------------ | ------ | -------- | --------------------------------- |
| `workItemId` | string | yes      | Id of the work item.              |
| `reason`     | string | yes      | Why the agent cannot take it now. |

### `heartbeat`

Shows the agent is alive and, optionally, still working on an item.

Sent by: agent. Answered by: `ack`, `error`.

| Field        | Type   | Required | Description                       |
| ------------ | ------ | -------- | --------------------------------- |
| `workItemId` | string | no       | The item being worked on, if any. |

### `progress`

A short status line about the item, shown to people.

Sent by: agent. Answered by: `ack`, `error`.

| Field        | Type   | Required | Description          |
| ------------ | ------ | -------- | -------------------- |
| `workItemId` | string | yes      | Id of the work item. |
| `text`       | string | yes      |                      |

### `journal`

Appends a line to the item's journal, which later rounds start from.

Sent by: agent. Answered by: `ack`, `error`.

| Field        | Type   | Required | Description          |
| ------------ | ------ | -------- | -------------------- |
| `workItemId` | string | yes      | Id of the work item. |
| `text`       | string | yes      |                      |

### `handback`

Finishes a round of the item with a summary.

Sent by: agent. Answered by: `ack`, `error`.

| Field           | Type                             | Required | Description                                                     |
| --------------- | -------------------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `workItemId`    | string                           | yes      | Id of the work item.                                            |
| `summary`       | string                           | yes      | What was done, decisions and open points.                       |
| `links`         | list of objects                  | yes      | Pull requests, documents and tickets touched.                   |
| `links[].url`   | string                           | yes      | Absolute URL.                                                   |
| `links[].title` | string                           | no       | Label for the link.                                             |
| `status`        | `done` or `waiting` or `blocked` | yes      | Whether the item is finished, waits for something, or is stuck. |

### `fail`

Reports that the agent could not do the item.

Sent by: agent. Answered by: `ack`, `error`.

| Field        | Type   | Required | Description          |
| ------------ | ------ | -------- | -------------------- |
| `workItemId` | string | yes      | Id of the work item. |
| `reason`     | string | yes      |                      |

### `ask`

Asks a teammate a question. The office routes it and may answer later.

Sent by: agent. Answered by: `ask_result`, `error`.

| Field        | Type   | Required | Description               |
| ------------ | ------ | -------- | ------------------------- |
| `to`         | string | yes      |                           |
| `question`   | string | yes      |                           |
| `workItemId` | string | no       | The asker's current item. |

### `ask_result`

The state of a question: answered, or still pending.

Sent by: office.

| Field    | Type                    | Required | Description         |
| -------- | ----------------------- | -------- | ------------------- |
| `id`     | string                  | yes      | Id of the question. |
| `to`     | string                  | yes      |                     |
| `status` | `answered` or `pending` | yes      |                     |
| `answer` | string                  | no       |                     |

### `answer`

Answers a question that was offered as a work item.

Sent by: agent. Answered by: `ack`, `error`.

| Field        | Type   | Required | Description |
| ------------ | ------ | -------- | ----------- |
| `questionId` | string | yes      |             |
| `answer`     | string | yes      |             |

### `roster`

Asks for the team and what everyone is doing.

Sent by: agent. Answered by: `roster_result`, `error`.

No payload fields.

### `roster_result`

The team.

Sent by: office.

| Field               | Type                                         | Required | Description                                       |
| ------------------- | -------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `members`           | list of objects                              | yes      |                                                   |
| `members[].handle`  | string                                       | yes      |                                                   |
| `members[].name`    | string                                       | yes      |                                                   |
| `members[].role`    | string                                       | yes      |                                                   |
| `members[].title`   | string                                       | no       | Display title of the role, for example Developer. |
| `members[].summary` | string                                       | no       | One line on what the role does.                   |
| `members[].status`  | `idle` or `working` or `paused` or `offline` | yes      |                                                   |
| `members[].current` | string                                       | no       | What the person is working on.                    |
| `humans`            | list of objects                              | no       | The trusted humans of the team.                   |
| `humans[].name`     | string                                       | yes      |                                                   |

### `work_list`

Asks for the caller's work items.

Sent by: agent. Answered by: `work_list_result`, `error`.

| Field        | Type   | Required | Description          |
| ------------ | ------ | -------- | -------------------- |
| `workItemId` | string | no       | Id of the work item. |

### `work_list_result`

The caller's work items.

Sent by: office.

| Field               | Type            | Required | Description                               |
| ------------------- | --------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `items`             | list of objects | yes      |                                           |
| `items[].id`        | string          | yes      |                                           |
| `items[].title`     | string          | yes      |                                           |
| `items[].status`    | string          | yes      |                                           |
| `items[].ticketKey` | string          | no       |                                           |
| `items[].prUrl`     | string          | no       |                                           |
| `items[].current`   | boolean         | no       | True for the item the caller asked about. |

### `work_move`

Changes the status of one of the caller's work items.

Sent by: agent. Answered by: `work_move_result`, `error`.

| Field        | Type                                | Required | Description          |
| ------------ | ----------------------------------- | -------- | -------------------- |
| `workItemId` | string                              | yes      | Id of the work item. |
| `status`     | `queued` or `blocked` or `canceled` | yes      | The new status.      |

### `work_move_result`

The item after the move.

Sent by: office.

| Field            | Type    | Required | Description                               |
| ---------------- | ------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `item`           | object  | yes      |                                           |
| `item.id`        | string  | yes      |                                           |
| `item.title`     | string  | yes      |                                           |
| `item.status`    | string  | yes      |                                           |
| `item.ticketKey` | string  | no       |                                           |
| `item.prUrl`     | string  | no       |                                           |
| `item.current`   | boolean | no       | True for the item the caller asked about. |

### `ack`

The request succeeded and has nothing to return.

Sent by: office.

No payload fields.

### `error`

A request failed, or a message was malformed or not understood. Never closes the connection by itself, except for authentication and version errors.

Sent by: either side.

| Field     | Type                                                                                                                                                                                                    | Required | Description |
| --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `code`    | `malformed` or `unknown_type` or `invalid_message` or `unauthenticated` or `auth_failed` or `version_mismatch` or `replaced` or `unknown_item` or `not_found` or `invalid` or `unsupported` or `failed` | yes      |             |
| `message` | string                                                                                                                                                                                                  | yes      |             |

### `ping`

Liveness check.

Sent by: either side. Answered by: `pong`.

No payload fields.

### `pong`

Answers a ping.

Sent by: either side.

No payload fields.
